Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Gripp wciąż ma klucz do Języka Syreny.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Wait - the model person - inside the ship? There's a way to work out who it is?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Chwila - ta figurka w środku - w statku? Da się ustalić, kto to jest?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Right. It was a crew of [i]three[/i] - not two.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Zgadza się. Załoga liczyła [i]troje[/i], nie dwoje.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Evidence?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Dowód?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Oh yeah, look at that.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: O tak, spójrzcie na to.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: -I really don't know why you're here, this doesn't concern you-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: -naprawdę nie wiem, po co tu jesteście, to was nie dotyczy-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: -in addition to Magnus Mortuga and Felicia Stonetop, I assume.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: -oprócz Magnusa Mortugi i Felicii Stonetop, jak sądzę.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: The audio was recorded [i]by[/i] the third person from the voyage.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Nagranie zostało zrobione [i]przez[/i] trzecią osobę z rejsu.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Mortuga is talking [i]about[/i] the third person from the voyage.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Mortuga mówi [i]o[/i] trzeciej osobie z rejsu.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Mortuga is talking [i]to[/i] the third person from the voyage.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Mortuga rozmawia [i]z[/i] trzecią osobą z rejsu.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [h]-is[/h] he? I only hear the one voice...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [h]-Niby[/h]? Ja słyszę tylko jeden głos...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Only, they're faulty - or [i]one[/i] of them is, at least - it turns itself on and off every few seconds.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Tyle że są wadliwe - a przynajmniej [i]jeden[/i] z nich - włącza się i wyłącza co kilka sekund.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: The cadence happened to line up with the conversation, so you only get [i]Mortuga's[/i] half.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Rytm akurat zbiegł się z rozmową, więc słyszysz tylko połowę [i]Mortugi[/i].
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: There are more things in heaven and earth, Mr Wirman...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Więcej jest rzeczy na niebie i ziemi, panie Wirman...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Zephyr

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Huh. That's... [i]quite[/i] the coincidence. Personally - if [i]I'd[/i] written that? - I'd feel guilty.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Hm. To... [i]niezły[/i] zbieg okoliczności. Osobiście - gdybym [i]ja[/i] to napisał - czułbym się winny.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: -what recording is [i]this?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: -co [i]to[/i] za nagranie?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: But... why would Mortuga include Gripp in his model town? Did they [i]know[/i] each other?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Ale... czemu Mortuga umieściłby Grippa w swojej makiecie miasteczka? Czy oni się [i]znali?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Wh-what about the [i]murder weapon?[/i] What happened to it?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: A-a co z [i]narzędziem zbrodni?[/i] Co się z nim stało?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Wouldn't he have needed that [i]special key?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Czy nie potrzebowałby tego [i]specjalnego klucza?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: The Ship in a Bottle...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Statek w Butelce...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [clue present, handheld radio]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [clue present, handheld radio]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Before it reached Mariana's pipe, the audio was transmitted from the cabin to the control room by these radios.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Zanim dotarło do rury głosowej Mariany, nagranie było przesyłane z kabiny do sterowni tymi radiami.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: I don't think they're who she's talking about.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Nie sądzę, że to o nich mówi.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [i]I[/i] can think of a way-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [i]Ja[/i] znam sposób-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [h]Let's -[/h] do it with logic and reasoning, shall we?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [h]Zróbmy to[/h] - metodą logiki i rozumowania, dobrze?
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Tch.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Tch.
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Selena too, I suppose, since she's the figurehead...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Selena też, jak sądzę, skoro jest galionową figurą...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Uh... ah-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Yy... ach-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: -even if it does - it is wholly unrelated our unfortunate voyage-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: -nawet jeśli tak, to nie ma to nic wspólnego z naszą nieszczęsną podróżą-
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [Static]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Pipe

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: The [i]third person...?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: [i]Trzecia osoba...?[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.en: Mortuga's film reel...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.pl: Taśma filmowa Mortugi...
Conversation/Grimoire 7 Parlor 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire
